structured.answer: If I have to choose: Harel, the "כספי (שקלי)" track, because Harel is the only company I know and that line shows 0% shares and 0% foreign currency. But it shows only 4.25% (3 years), which isn't more than my deposits, so I'll ask my son or the bank before I sign anything.

Six or seven numbers in every line, with circles. I didn't know which to look at, so I only looked at the מניות percentage and the company name
This is the track I'd have wanted (government bonds), but it shows an orange mark and 'עוד לא דווח', and I don't know Meitav well
Tired and anxious from the numbers; stopped and didn't see the remaining nine screens
